title: Optional optimizations
machine: edge-os-arm64-vm (comparative proxy; physical Pi 5 pending D8/D10)

hardware_disclosure.physical_pi5: NOT connected; every CPU cost is an edge-os VM measurement x the E02/E03 Pi multiplier s; delivered AUC is simulated delivery on replayed detections
hardware_disclosure.machine_tag: edge-os-arm64-vm (comparative proxy; physical Pi 5 pending D8/D10)
hardware_disclosure.isa_note: the VM exposes asimddp, i8mm, bf16; Cortex-A76 (Pi 5) has dot-product only: INT8 speed-ups are an upper bound
hardware_disclosure.mv_note: MV streams are our own x264 IPPP re-encode of the dataset frames (UBnormal: second generation), not camera streams

qat.note: INT8 vs deployed NCNN FP16 baseline, locked tracker, all clips; delivered = matched-cost cell average on ShanghaiTech (all clips)

cadence_aware_scorer.rule: fires only if reuse at full coverage (K = 1, zero delay) costs more than 0.25 pt of ideal AUC

longer_pose_finetuning.note: the oracle-detection (detector-recall-limited vs ideal) series needed for this gate was not built in E04; proxy only: E03 attributes 94 % of missed events to the scorer

E4-D1.detail: E03 Cache-C1 and Motion-Only replayed through the extended simulator in 12 cells x 2 datasets: delivered series, ideal series, cost, knob and target bit-identical; the rebuilt run tables equal E03's

E4-D2.detail: one MV record per labelled frame in every clip; a known global translation of 4 px / frame is recovered from the exported vectors; re-encoding 3 clips gives identical grids and statistics (NaN == NaN)

E4-D3.detail: numpy copies of the E03 observers used in the VM equal the E03 functions

E4-D4.detail: E04-session ML0 NCNN pose pool within 10 % of E02's (all T); host CPU outside the VM < 30 %; no cell excluded after retries

E4-D5.detail: 200 frames, seed 0, training/videos only; re-quantising reproduces the identical file hash

E4-D6.detail: C1 never reuses a detector output older than A1 or taken after the current frame; an invalid MV (NaN: key frame) never validates a reuse

E4-D7.detail: INT8 cache: 107 clips, one record per frame, frame ids 0..n-1; re-running 2 clips with the same command reproduces every output field (detections, keypoints, counts, luma) bit for bit; host timing fields (*_ms) are excluded
